bio.lead: In his own words, on his model:

bio.text: He enjoyed continuing success as an artist, and continuing financial troubles, for forty-five years. His paintings still exemplify the visual image of Elizabethan England, very different from that of most of Europe in the late sixteenth century.
our first great English miniaturist, whose portraits had a marvellous reputation in his lifetime and among his immediate successors.
